title: BetterWaystonesMenu Fork
description: 1.20.1 port of BetterWaystonesMenu with pinyin search, dimension filter, and Chinese config.
body:
---

> A 1.20.1 port of [Loxoz's BetterWaystonesMenu](https://github.com/Loxoz/BetterWaystonesMenu) with new features including pinyin search, dimension filter, and Chinese config localization.

**[GitHub](https://github.com/Elten-huanghuang/BetterWaystonesMenu-1.20.1)** | **[中文说明](https://www.google.com/search?q=https://github.com/Elten-huanghuang/BetterWaystonesMenu-1.20.1/blob/main/README_zh.md)**

---

## New Features

* **Pinyin Search** — Search Chinese waystone names using pinyin (e.g., `zsj` → 主世界)
* **Dimension Filter** — Filter waystones by dimension (Overworld / Nether / End)
* **`#` Search** — Type `#overworld` to search by dimension
* **Bilingual Config** — Chinese + English config file comments

---

## Features (from original)

* Real-time search with multi-word matching
* Sort by Index / Name / Distance
* Favorites (Ctrl+click), Groups, Drag-to-rearrange
* Multi-language: English, Chinese, French, Spanish, Portuguese

---

## Dependencies

* [Forge 47.3.0+](https://files.minecraftforge.net/)
* [Balm 7.3.38+](https://modrinth.com/mod/balm)
* [Waystones 14.1.5+](https://modrinth.com/mod/waystones)

---
